Add notes about the whole map

Source: R/add_map_notes.R
add_map_notes.Rd

Adds a small "Notes" button that opens a panel with context about the map and its data: where the data come from, what the figures do not include, and a link to learn more. Unlike a tooltip, the notes are about the whole map, not about one feature. They start collapsed, so they do not cover the map, and open with a click.

Usage

add_map_notes(
  map,
  source = NULL,
  notes = NULL,
  link = NULL,
  link_label = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  position = "bottom-left",
  width = 280,
  collapsed = TRUE,
  fade = c("none", "moving"),
  labels = context_labels()
)

Arguments

map

A map created with mapgl::maplibre() or mapgl::mapboxgl().

source

Where the data come from, such as "INDEC, 2022 census".

notes

One or more notes about the map or its data, each shown as a bullet, such as what the figures do not include.

link

Optional web address to learn more, starting with http:// or https://. It opens in a new tab.

link_label

Text of the link. NULL (the default) uses the notes_link label, "More information".

title

Title of the panel. NULL (the default) uses the notes_title label, "Notes".

position

Corner for the notes: one of "bottom-left" (the default), "bottom-right", "top-left" or "top-right".

width

Width of the open panel in pixels.

collapsed

If TRUE (the default), the notes start collapsed to a small button. FALSE shows them open.

fade

"moving" fades the panel while the map is panned or zoomed. "none" (the default) keeps it always solid.

labels

Panel texts, as returned by context_labels().

Value

The modified map object.

Details

Texts are shown as plain text, never as HTML.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(mapgl)

maplibre(center = c(-64, -38.5), zoom = 3.4) |>
  add_fill_layer(id = "departments", source = ar_departments, fill_color = "#9ecae1") |>
  add_map_notes(
    source = "INDEC, population projections 2022-2035.",
    notes = c(
      "Growth is the total change between 2022 and 2035, not per year.",
      "Islas del Atlantico Sur is not included: it has no estimates."
    ),
    link = "https://www.indec.gob.ar"
  )
} # }
